entries.title: Lodestar is now on games.radgh.com
items: Lodestar is now on games.radgh.com — command a frontier town from your bunker desk and watch it grow on the Tactical Scope.
Mine ore, lay roads, raise workshops and research new plans; settlers move in once there is food, water and room.
Build walls and towers before the raids arrive, and refine mana crystal to call down spells from the Spell Board.
Every fire, flood, blast and frost runs on real cell physics, so the land burns, floods and freezes as you would expect.
Plays with a mouse, keyboard, touch or a controller. Hover lamps and readouts on the desk to see what they mean.
